name: New Securities Issuance Type 5 Code
definition: Specifies the type of securities proceeds; whether they are newly issued or not, defeased or non-defeased.

DEFE.name: Defeased Security Indicator
DEFE.definition: Funds have been placed in escrow by a trustee or agent to ensure payment on a portion of the outstanding balance of the original security on maturity date. Applicable only in the frame of a Partial Defeasance PDEF corporate action event.

EXIS.name: Existing Issue
EXIS.definition: Securities proceeds are not new issues.

NDEF.name: Non Defeased Security Indicator
NDEF.definition: Funds will not be guaranteed at maturity by the issuer or paying agent for this newly issued non-defeased security. Applicable only in the frame of a Partial Defeasance PDEF corporate action event.

UKWN.name: Unknown
UKWN.definition: Not known whether the securities proceeds are newly issued or not.

NREF.name: Non Refunded Security Indicator
NREF.definition: New Security issued that has not been refunded and the maturity date of the original underlying security is unchanged. Applicable only in the frame of a Partial Defeasance PDEF corporate action event.

REFU.name: Refunded Security Indicator
REFU.definition: New security issued that has been refunded to an earlier maturity date. Applicable only in the frame of a partial defeasance PDEF corporate action event.
